blocks.title: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
blocks.text: BFS graph ke tamam nodes level ba level, diye gaye root node se shuru kar ke, khangalta hai, aur baqi nodes ka hisab rakhne ke liye queue istemal karta hai.

items: Root node se shuru kar ke use queue mein dalein.
Queue se node nikal kar process karein aur us ke tamam na dekhe gaye parosi queue mein dalein.

blocks.text: Social network mein, jahan nodes log aur edges dostiyan hain, BFS do logon ke darmiyan sab se chhota raasta, yaani degree of separation, dhoond sakta hai. BFS O(V + E) waqt leta hai, jahan V vertices aur E edges ki tadaad hai.

blocks.prompt: Jarr 0, bachche 1, 2, 3 aur pote 4, 5 (1 ke neeche), 6 (2 ke neeche) aur 7 (3 ke neeche) wale darakht mein BFS kis tarteeb se jata hai?

items: BFS: queue, level ba level; be-wazan graphs mein sab se chhote raaste; O(V + E).
